meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 为已经装好的 Dial 渠道再添加一个电话号码,使同一个 NanoClaw 能用多个号码接短信和 AI 语音电话。每个号码是独立会话线,对方用哪个号联系,就从哪个号回复,可指定由哪一组代理负责。
howto.when: 在 Dial 已安装、操作者想增加一个额外号码(如个人号加客服号)时触发;需要先装好 Dial(/add-dial)。

say.text: 给 Dial 渠道再加一个号码 +14155550123
say.note: 启动多号码添加流程,先确认号码归属和代理组。

say.text: 把 +14155550123 接到客服代理组,权限设为 public
say.note: 为该号码创建独立线程并接线,重启后生效。

say.text: 帮 Dial 增加一条只允许已知用户的线路
say.note: 走新增向导时选 strict,限制谁能联系这条线。

howto.what_en: Adds another Dial number to an installed channel, so one NanoClaw install can serve multiple numbers. Each new number is a separate threaded line; replies are sent from the contacted number, and it is bound to a chosen agent group.
howto.when_en: Use when Dial is already installed and an operator wants an extra number, e.g. a support line in addition to a personal line. Requires /add-dial to have been run first.

say_en.text: Add another number to the Dial channel, e.g. +14155550123.
say_en.note: Starts the multi-number flow and confirms the number belongs to the account.

say_en.text: Connect +14155550123 to the support agent group and set access to public.
say_en.note: Creates a new threaded line for this number and restarts to apply it.

say_en.text: Add another Dial line that only known users can text.
say_en.note: Runs the add-number wizard and applies a strict inbound policy.
